LOGIN_ALERT.subject: New sign-in to your account
LOGIN_ALERT.body: Your account was just signed in to. If this wasn't you, please contact support.

PASSWORD_CHANGED.subject: Your password was changed
PASSWORD_CHANGED.body: Your account password was changed from your current session. If this wasn't you, please contact support immediately.

PASSWORD_CHANGED_VIA_OTP.subject: Your password was reset
PASSWORD_CHANGED_VIA_OTP.body: Your account password was reset using a one-time code. If this wasn't you, please contact support.

PASSWORD_CHANGED_VIA_RECOVERY_CODE.subject: Your password was reset
PASSWORD_CHANGED_VIA_RECOVERY_CODE.body: Your account password was reset using a recovery code. If this wasn't you, please contact support.

IDENTIFIER_PURGED.subject: An identifier was removed
IDENTIFIER_PURGED.body: One of your account's identifiers was removed. If this wasn't you, please contact support.

SECOND_FACTOR_ENABLED.subject: Two-factor authentication enabled
SECOND_FACTOR_ENABLED.body: Two-factor authentication was enabled on your account. If this wasn't you, please contact support.

SECOND_FACTOR_RESET.subject: Two-factor authentication reset
SECOND_FACTOR_RESET.body: Two-factor authentication was reset on your account. If this wasn't you, please contact support.

RECOVERY_CODES_REGENERATED.subject: Recovery codes regenerated
RECOVERY_CODES_REGENERATED.body: Your account's recovery codes were regenerated. If this wasn't you, please contact support.

ASSIGNMENT_GRANTED.subject: A role was assigned to you
ASSIGNMENT_GRANTED.body: You were granted the "{role}" role in {realm}.

REALM_EXCLUDED.subject: You were removed from a realm
